let reads = 0;
const object = {
  get only() { reads++; return 1; },
  get both() { reads++; return 2; },
  set both(value: number) { reads += value; },
};
for (const getters of ['all', 1, ['get'], false, 'get', 'set', true]) {
  console.dir(object, { getters });
  console.log(reads);
}
const method = Object.prototype.toLocaleString;
for (const receiver of [null, undefined]) {
  try { method.call(receiver); }
  catch (error) { if (error instanceof Error) console.log(error.message); }
}
const custom = {
  n: 12,
  get toString() {
    console.log('read toString');
    return function (this: { n: number }) { return 'custom ' + this.n; };
  },
};
console.log(method.call(custom), method.call(42));
